reasoning_content:
Next, restart the asr-service so that it picks up the new configuration. Note that the models have already been "initialized" (no wait, actually /models/.initialized was never touched, because the mv failed. The entrypoint checks `[ ! -f /models/.initialized ] || [ ! -f /models/diarization.generated.yaml ]` — both are missing, so model_download will be re-run on every restart. The faster-whisper model is cached (3.5G... no wait, that was the directory size including metadata. The model.bin blob is around 3GB — actually du showed the model directory total as 3.5M, and blobs/28/... is the actual 3GB file inside the xet directory. The hf directory total is 3.0G. Good — snapshot_download should be fast thanks to the cache.)

But the download of the pyannote model will fail again (401), and `model_download` will `exit(1)` → the entrypoint will proceed to `python -m asr_service` (no set -e), so the service will start up. OK — same as last time.

Restart and test.
